description: This PHP source file defines the 'nusoap_base' class, which is part of the NuSOAP web services toolkit. It includes collection of utility functions, constants, and methods for serializing PHP data into XML for SOAP messaging, handling error/debug info, managing namespaces, and supporting SOAP-specific data types. The class serves as a foundational component for building and parsing SOAP messages within the NuSOAP library.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: A core utility class providing methods for SOAP message serialization, namespace management, debugging, error handling, and type encoding support within NuSOAP.
